subject: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Lin <maya@cloudbridge.com>, CloudBridge Partnerships <partners@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps

Hi Maya / CloudBridge team —

Great to connect at KubeCon — thanks for the intro to Tom at AWS. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass co-sell playbook tailored to solution partners integrating Redwood Inference with managed ML pipelines. The goal: a lightweight, repeatable enablement flow your field sellers can use when engaging mid-market SaaS accounts.

Key asks for this thread:
- Review the draft playbook (attached PDF) and highlight any technical gaps or positioning tweaks by EOD next Tue (Aug 3).
- Confirm who on your side will be the co-sell point-of-contact and whether you have an existing partner enablement deck we should align on.
- Marcus and Vanessa from our side will scope a short one-hour joint enablement for CloudBridge sellers the week of Aug 10.

I also attached a mutual-action-plan (Excel) with proposed milestones — please update the timeline column if your timelines differ.

Thanks, and happy to hop on a quick call if that helps triage items.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships 
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: CBP_Redwood_co-sell_playbook_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 230KB), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

From: Maya Lin <maya@cloudbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partners@cloudbridge.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aws-partner.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for sending this over — good framing. Quick notes after an initial pass:
- Playbook looks solid; would prefer stronger callouts around supported deployment modes (Hosted vs. Dedicated vs. Private) so our sellers can match customer security posture quickly.
- Need a one-pager for our AE/SE handoff called "When to propose Redwood Dedicated" — can your team draft that?
- On timelines: our enablement week of Aug 10 works but we have two internal enablement conflicts on Aug 11. Could do Aug 12 or Aug 13.

I'll loop in Tom from AWS to check if there are any co-sell commitments we should be aware of before we present to joint accounts — he copied him in. Our partner lead (Sarah) will be the day-to-day; I'll send her contact once I confirm.

Maya
Director, Strategic Partnerships
CloudBridge Partners
maya@cloudbridge.com
+1 (206) 555-0123

On attachments: I uploaded the playbook draft to our partner drive and added comments on the security section.

---
Forwarded-for-context: Tom Reynolds (AWS)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aws-partner.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps

Hi all — quick note from AWS partner co-sell: we typically ask for a validated solution brief and a joint value proposition slide that maps the customer pain to an AWS/Partner/ISV stack. Happy to provide a template and introduce you to the regional co-sell rep once you have the brief.

Tom Reynolds
Sr Partner Manager, ISV Acceleration
AWS Marketplace

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: CloudBridge Partnerships <partners@cloudbridge.com>, Maya Lin <maya@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps

Thanks Maya — good feedback. A couple of responses and proposed updates:

1) Deployment shortfalls: Marcus will add a concise decision matrix to the playbook that maps common customer profiles to Hosted / Dedicated / Private (2/3 bullets each). Expect v1.1 by Aug 4.

2) "When to propose Redwood Dedicated" one-pager — Vanessa will draft; target Aug 6.

3) Enablement slot: let's lock Aug 12 at 10:00 PT for the joint seller session. Marcus, Vanessa — can you confirm?

4) Tom — appreciate the AWS template offer. If you can share the solution brief template, we'll populate it and send back for an intro to the regional co-sell rep.

Next steps (updated in the attached mutual-action-plan):
- Aug 4: Playbook v1.1 (Marcus)
- Aug 6: Dedicated one-pager (Vanessa)
- Aug 9: Redwood internal prep call (Sergio + Aisha)
- Aug 12: Joint seller enablement (joint)

If no objections, I'll send a calendar invite for Aug 12 and share the Drive folder link in this thread.

Thanks,
Sergio

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated), CBP_Redwood_co-sell_playbook_draft_v1.1.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell enablement: draft playbook and next steps

All — confirmed for Aug 12 at 10:00 PT. Quick internal notes before the joint session:

- Marcus: I'll need the deployment decision matrix and the one-pager bullet points by EOD Aug 4 so I can turn them into slides.
- Aisha: please prepare a 10-min segment on "verification and compliance" (SOC 2 evidence, supported KMS patterns) — CloudBridge sellers will ask/tell customers about compliance posture.
- Sergio: I'll draft the "When to propose Redwood Dedicated" one-pager and share a template in Drive (will attach to the M-A-P).

I'll also add a slide that maps the co-sell compensation motion (referral vs. co-sell) as requested by Maya — Marcus, do we have a short blurb from Finance on how revenue gets split for marketplace-initiated deals? If not, I can ask.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM Lead
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

On attachments: uploading CBP_Redwood_co-sell_playbook_draft_v1.1.pdf and updated mutual-action-plan.xlsx to drive now.
